name: Intro & Commercial Skipper
description: Detects recurring episode intros/outros via cross-episode audio fingerprinting, and commercial breaks via Comskip .edl import or a built-in black-frame/silence heuristic, exposing them as native skippable media segments.
overview: Fingerprints episode audio to find recurring intros/outros across a season, and imports Comskip .edl files (or runs a heuristic black-frame/silence scan) to find commercial breaks in recorded broadcast content.
changelog: 0.1.2.0: Switched intro/outro fingerprinting to use ffmpeg's own Chromaprint muxer instead of a separate fpcalc binary (which jellyfin-ffmpeg does not ship), fixed the config page showing blank fields, and stopped caching a false 'no segments' result when ffmpeg fails to even launch. 0.1.1.0: Fixed a startup crash (NullReferenceException in PluginServiceRegistrator) caused by reading Plugin.Instance before it was set. 0.1.0.0: Initial release.
